notes.title: Steam Trading Cards
notes.content:
Because of the Steam ban for the release of Trading Cards immediately after the start of the game (http://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845), they will appear only when a certain threshold of purchases is reached.

We want to show you the rewards for Trading Cards for NYAN DESTROYER.
